name: Liller 1 (Webb)
blurb: Liller 1, a globular cluster in the bulge of the Milky Way, seen by Webb.
label: c1730333-webb
story: Liller 1 hides behind thick dust in the Milky Way's crowded bulge, and its stars belong to at least two populations of remarkably different ages. Webb watched it for ultracompact binary stars and variable stars, in a cluster whose gamma-ray glow hints at a vast population of pulsars.
